description: Cheapest fleet-wide maintenance check; takes no parameters. Returns an object keyed by printer id, each entry holding status (in_maintenance, due or scheduled) and next_scheduled_date. Only printers with a scheduled or in-progress job appear, so a printer that is absent has no maintenance outstanding and an empty object means nothing is scheduled anywhere. Follow up with get_printer_maintenance_profile for one printer, or list_maintenance_jobs for job-level detail.
name: get_maintenance_status_map
